text: Long-term Classes (one year) enroll new students twice annually in March and September respectively, offering five levels: elementary, intermediate and advanced courses and so on. Students are expected to attend 22~24 hours of required courses and 2~8 hours of selective courses per week from Monday to Friday. Note: You could attend the long-term autumn and spring Chinese Learning courses in the mid-time for learning 2 or 3 months if you have the corresponding Chinese foundation. Required Courses Threshold and Elementary Classes: intensive reading (including grammar), listening comprehension, oral Chinese, Chinese character reading and writing Intermediate and Advanced Classes: intensive reading (including grammar), listening comprehension, oral Chinese, Chinese writing, Chinese reading and Chinese culture. Selective Courses Shadowboxing, calligraphy, ancient Chinese, business Chinese, Chinese and foreign movie class, and coaching classes for HSK Test. Features of the Course: focusing on the training of the students' ability to use the language in practice; class size is kept in an average of 20 people; Chinese language practicing activities for a week is organized every semester with all students participating; a good language environment is provided by the school for students to practice in. We have highly qualified and experienced teaching staff that ensures the quality of teaching and significant teaching achievements.
